bat: A fruit bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Its wings are broad dark leathery membranes stretched between long slender finger bones, with a small hooked thumb claw at the leading edge of each. A FOX-LIKE FACE with a long pointed muzzle, large dark round eyes and simple pointed ears, russet-brown fur over its head and shoulders, a compact furry body, small clawed feet tucked up beneath it
egyptianfruitbat: An Egyptian fruit bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Broad dark grey-brown leathery wing membranes stretched between long finger bones. A dog-like face with a short blunt muzzle, very large dark eyes, and neat pointed ears, sandy-brown fur with a paler collar around its throat, a compact body, small feet tucked up beneath it
vampirebat: A common vampire bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Broad greyish-brown leathery wing membranes with unusually long thumbs. A SHORT FLATTENED FACE with NO TAIL, a blunt squashed pig-like snout with a fleshy pad and a deep groove, small pointed ears, tiny dark eyes, and two long sharp white upper incisors just visible. Greyish-brown fur, a compact body
fishingbat: A greater bulldog bat IN FLIGHT low over water, flying with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. ITS HIND FEET ARE ENORMOUS, hanging down below its body on long legs and armed with BIG CURVED HOOKED CLAWS for gaffing fish. Long narrow pointed wings in orange-brown leather. A BULLDOG-LIKE FACE with full drooping jowls, a split upper lip, a blunt muzzle and small eyes. Bright rusty-orange fur
greaterhorseshoebat: A greater horseshoe bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Broad rounded greyish-brown wing membranes. THE FACE IS THE KEY FEATURE: an ELABORATE FLESHY HORSESHOE-SHAPED NOSE-LEAF, a pale rounded U-shaped flap of skin encircling the nostrils with a pointed spearhead of skin standing up above it. Very large broad pointed ears with no inner spike, small dark eyes, soft grey-brown fur
littlebrownbat: A little brown bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. High in empty open air with clear sky all around and nothing else in the picture at all. A very small bat with dark brown leathery wing membranes stretched between fine finger bones, and a TAIL MEMBRANE stretched between its hind legs. Glossy warm brown fur, a small blunt muzzle, tiny black eyes, and short rounded dark ears
freetailbat: A Mexican free-tailed bat IN FLIGHT, flying fast through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. High in empty open air with clear sky all around and nothing else in the picture at all. VERY LONG NARROW POINTED WINGS built for speed, dark grey-brown leather. A THICK BARE TAIL PROJECTING WELL BEYOND THE EDGE OF ITS TAIL MEMBRANE like a free rat-like tail. Broad forward-tilted ears that nearly meet over its forehead, a wrinkled upper lip, bristly toes, dark grey-brown fur
pallidbat: A pallid bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. High in empty open air with clear sky all around and nothing else in the picture at all. PALE CREAM-BLONDE FUR, noticeably light coloured, over a paler almost white belly, with pale sandy wing membranes. ENORMOUS BROAD PALE EARS, very large and separate and held forward, and a BLUNT PIG-LIKE SNOUT with a raised horseshoe ridge above the nostrils. Large dark eyes
longnosedbat: A lesser long-nosed bat IN FLIGHT, hovering in open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. High in empty open air with clear sky all around and nothing else in the picture at all. A LONG SLENDER POINTED MUZZLE with a small triangular nose-leaf at the tip, and A LONG NARROW PINK TONGUE EXTENDED FORWARD from its mouth for drinking nectar. Cinnamon-brown fur dusted with pale yellow pollen around its face and shoulders, narrow pointed wings, small ears, dark eyes
whitetentbat: A Honduran white bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. A tiny bat with PURE SNOW-WHITE FLUFFY FUR all over its round cottonball body, and PALE TRANSLUCENT GREY WING MEMBRANES. A BRIGHT YELLOW-ORANGE LEAF-SHAPED NOSE standing up on its face like a little triangular flag, BRIGHT YELLOW-ORANGE EARS, and small dark shining eyes
